Commentary.Commentary: ...THE CHASE...

Pakistan were quite underpar with their bowling. The likes of Shaheen, Rauf and Shadad looked rusty. For the second time in a row they have gone for over 300. Now it is onto their batters to score big on a wicket which did seem like it was holding up. Can they deliver against a strong Australian bowling attack?

A strong show with the bat by the Aussies. It was the openers who laid the foundation but then there was a mini collapse. However, Maxwell along with Green laid the platform and Inglis added the finishing touches. Australia will be very pleased with Maxwell, Inglis and Green scoring runs and will also be happy with their batting performance.
